title: Outline als Standard
slide_intent: Use fill as a meaningful distinction so state or small-size clarity does not depend on arbitrary styling.
strategic_value: A consistent outline default can make filled DB icons carry an intelligible exception.
demonstration: Hearts compare outline and filled versions at three sizes; stars show off and on states.
practical_value: Default to outlines; use fill for restricted visibility at the smallest size or active/inactive state.

content_islands.name: Size comparison
content_islands.spec: Arrange outline hearts above filled hearts in three sizes.

content_islands.name: State comparison
content_islands.spec: Pair outlined off and filled on stars at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples show fill used for small-size visibility and state.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Outline is the default; fill is permitted when the smallest icon is hard to see and for active/inactive states.
